title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초1 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 061 ]

blocks.text: Lately, my husband’s company doesn’t open on Saturdays, so we have lots of free time to spend together.
I use my weekend time to learn new things.
I get up late on Saturday and sometimes we either go somewhere with our children, or we usually go to the public baths (spa) to release stress.
I also try to exercise, shop, and practice my English.
